name: kami
title_zh: 羊皮纸底色配墨蓝强调的文档排版师
tagline_zh: 简历、白皮书、落地页、PPT 都排成同一套书香门第的气质。中文字体自动切 TsangerJinKai02。
tagline_en: Resumes, whitepapers, landing pages, slides — all set in one warm, bookish style. Auto CJK fonts, serif-led.
desc_en: Typeset professional documents and product landing pages: resumes, one-pagers, white papers, letters, portfolios, slide decks, landing pages. Warm parchment, ink-blue accent, serif-led hierarchy. CN uses TsangerJinKai02, EN uses Charter, JA uses YuMincho (best-effort). Triggers on "做 PDF / 排版 / 一页纸 / 白皮书 / 作品集 / 简历 / PPT / slides / Marp / markdown slides / マークダウンのスライド / 落地页 / 官网 / landing page / p
why_zh: 不是套模板，是按内容层级选字体和间距，让专业文档长得像同一家出版社出的。
why_en: Not a template pack: it maps content structure to type scale and spacing, so every document looks like it left the same quality.
limit_zh: 只认 Markdown 输入；不处理 DOCX/PDF 原稿。日文字体是尽力而为，缺字体就回退系统默认。
limit_en: Markdown in only; no DOCX/PDF editing. JA font is best-effort, falls back if missing. Output is typeset PDF/Marp, not copy editing.
title_en: Parchment-and-ink typesetter for resumes, decks & landing.
